scripts.dev:aio: pnpm run db:migrate:aio && pnpm --filter @az/aio-desktop tauri dev
scripts.lint: pnpm --filter @az/ui lint && pnpm --filter @az/admin-shell lint && pnpm --filter @az/api-client lint && pnpm --filter @az/remote-ui lint && pnpm --filter @az/aio-front lint
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @az/ui test && pnpm --filter @az/admin-shell test && pnpm --filter @az/api-client test && pnpm --filter @az/remote-ui test
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @az/ui typecheck && pnpm --filter @az/admin-shell typecheck && pnpm --filter @az/api-client typecheck && pnpm --filter @az/remote-ui typecheck && pnpm --filter @az/aio-front lint
